subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned 20-open-PR policy notice remain open/pinned, or should it be retired now that the docs and automation already carry the policy?
rationale: The source state is already implemented and shipped, but the live timeline shows a maintainer deliberately reopened and pinned this notice, so automation should not decide the communication policy on its own.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice
options.body: Keep this issue open and pinned as the public short-form policy notice while the 20-PR cap remains active.

options.title: Retire the notice
options.body: Unpin and close this issue, relying on `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the automation response as the canonical contributor guidance.

options.title: Revise the policy
options.body: Change the cap or exception path, then update the issue, docs, labeler workflow, and Barnacle response together.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and pinned as the public short-form policy notice while the 20-PR cap remains active.

likelyOwner.reason: This person performed the latest human rename, pin, and reopen actions for the notice.
